subject: ela
skillName: Analyze modern fiction's relationship to source texts
intro: Analyze how modern fiction draws on source texts.

items.prompt:
A traditional story that explains the world or nature is a:
A) myth
B) textbook
C) recipe

A hero who leaves home, faces trials, and returns follows the hero's:
A) journey/quest
B) grocery list
C) schedule

Making an old pattern feel fresh is called:
A) rendering it new
B) copying it
C) deleting it

A superhero gains a power, faces a great evil, and sacrifices himself for others. This draws on the ancient pattern of the:
A) hero's journey/heroic sacrifice
B) grocery trip
C) weather report

steps: Classic hero myth. Key is A.

items.prompt:
A novelist retells an ancient world-flood myth. One way to RENDER it new is to:
A) set it in the future with a climate-driven flood and new characters
B) copy it word for word
C) change nothing
items.answer: A) set it in the future with a climate-driven flood and new characters

solution.answer: A) set it in the future with a climate-driven flood and new characters

items.prompt:
Why do modern stories reuse ANCIENT patterns?
A) they are timeless and resonate with readers
B) authors cannot invent anything
C) it is required by law
items.answer: A) they are timeless and resonate with readers

solution.answer: A) they are timeless and resonate with readers

items.prompt:
A modern young-adult novel features a 'chosen one' who must defeat a dark lord with the help of a wise old mentor. This novel draws on:
A) archetypes and patterns from myth and traditional tales
B) nothing older than itself
C) only historical facts
items.answer: A) archetypes and patterns from myth and traditional tales

solution.answer: A) archetypes and patterns from myth and traditional tales

items.prompt:
When analyzing how a modern work draws on a source, the KEY question is:
A) what pattern it borrows AND how it makes it new
B) only the page count
C) only the author's name
items.answer: A) what pattern it borrows AND how it makes it new

solution.answer: A) what pattern it borrows AND how it makes it new
